sources.role: Samsung official SM-S928B/DS nominal dimensions 162.3 x 79.0 x 8.6 mm; native display 3120 x 1440 pixels.
Samsung design photographs, curved titanium side rails and flat display; side image used for calibrated secondary dimensions.
Official side rendering, local samsung-elevation-3.jpg (1068 x 464); body depth y 177..255, top end x265.
Samsung official front/back rendering. Front body approximately x513..849, y83..782; screen approximately x525..837, y96..770. Composited product art has slight scaling/perspective uncertainty.

Manufacturer rear product elevation reproduced by retailer, 1263 x 1417 PNG. Body x330..941, y92..1346. Large camera centres (446.5,200), (446.5,342), (446.5,484); small centres (575,200),(575,342); flash (575,272). Large rings radius58.8 px; small radius35 px.
Samsung official user guide pages12-13. Feature location diagrams including microphone, air vent, laser AF, S Pen, SIM and speaker. Not dimensioned mechanical CAD.
Firsthand physical-device photographs P1051260(top), P1051267(right), P1051280(left), P1051317(bottom), P1051341/P1051362(S Pen), P1051150(cameras). Used for shapes/arrangement, not specs.
